title: The Pirate Crew Could Fire the Captain #Shorts
description:
On a pirate ship, the crew could fire the captain. On many pirate ships, the crew voted for their captain... and could vote him out. In battle, his word was law. But the rest of the time, another elected officer, the quartermaster, handled food, loot and fights.
